acceptance.grading: Both assembly branches use their deterministic current outcome surface. Without B use verified primary evidence inspector and check model-visible conclusion/drafts for contradictions. Direct uses last model result plus actual observed ordinary SQL.
acceptance.materiality: At least one additional strict whole-case completion versus previous on this 3-case panel with zero false accepted outcomes in the both arm; separately compare direct and conventional. Findings are finite-panel measurements, not a superiority or broad inference proof.
acceptance.missing: Withhold total and precisely locate the missing cell. A request denied by evidence is useful but does not by itself constitute a complete member-facing abstention.
acceptance.numerical: Correct exact registry metric and an actual operation on approved primary bytes; retained same artifact exactly solves withheld rows without retuning; coherent member-facing outcome with no unsupported primary claim. Bound quantities must match independent reference and registered unit.

information: Same native requirements including evaluator-frozen references where they exist. Constructor prompts must strip these values. All model arms have identical initial observations, explicit schema, semantics, scope, tool opportunities and token/time budgets. A delivers machine-resolved schema tooling and B projects accepted output. Direct gets ordinary read-only SQLite on the exact approved schema and Boolean observed reference agreement. Conventional uses Python Fraction over the same data.
sealed_custody: Separate authoring context on one administrator and workspace. Initial authorized rows are sent to models. Confirmation rows and exact reference values remain evaluator-only. Before candidate dispatch source identity freezes. No protected account separation claim.
stopping: Run each registered arm at most once per case. Keep exhausted, failed and interrupted cases. No rerun to select results. Pause before new dispatch on binding failure, invalid model route or changed sources. Budget/availability truncation leaves exact unrun denominators. Prospective security or acceptance changes require a new preregistered cohort.
